model: 1D-CNN (cnn-v3), dropout 0.3: Conv1d(122->32->64, ReLU, Dropout) x2, AdaptiveAvgPool1d, Linear->n_classes. Trained WITH frame-level augmentation (hand-frame dropout 0-50%, scale +/-10%, rotation +/-10 deg, time-warp +/-15%).

features.normalisation: MediaPipe Left/Right labels IGNORED. Hands assigned to two stable physical slots by temporal tracking (nearest wrist to previous frame; two hands in one frame ordered by image x, then continuity). ACTIVE slot = hand with larger total wrist travel (tie: more frames present); other = SECONDARY. Per-frame: wrist - shoulder_centre / shoulder_width; other 20 landmarks - wrist / hand_size (hand_size = ||wrist - middle fingertip||). If the active hand's mean wrist x is image-left of the shoulder midpoint, all x coords (hands + face) are mirrored about the per-frame shoulder midpoint so the active hand is right-hand-active. Missing runs <=5 frames interpolated; longer/leading/trailing missing kept as zero coords with mask=0, never normalised into shoulder space.

extractor.name: @mediapipe/tasks-vision HolisticExtractor
extractor.note: Same options as the SignSage frontend (frontend/src/features/translate/landmarks.ts): pose numPoses=1, face numFaces=1, hands numHands=2, delegate GPU, no confidence thresholds set (MediaPipe defaults), no delegate fallback. Coordinates are NOT mirrored; only the preview is CSS-mirrored (scaleX(-1)) like the app.

fps_note: Features resampled to 60 frames per clip (uniform subsample if T>=60, edge-pad if T<60). Effective FPS varies per clip; the model is invariant to this via resampling. Coordinates are NOT mirrored (only the app preview is CSS-mirrored); canonicalisation mirroring is applied inside features_v3.
threshold_note: Calibrated on the S2 DEV set (train S1, test S2, cnn-v3, 50 clips, 10 CORE words, no rest). S2 max-softmax threshold table: 0.5 -> acc 0.6458333333333334 coverage 0.96; 0.7 -> acc 0.6756756756756757 coverage 0.74 (recommended operating point); 0.9 -> acc 0.6 coverage 0.5; argmax -> acc 0.64 coverage 100%. Stated as calibrated on S2 only; S2 was used to diagnose the handedness problem, so this is NOT a clean held-out test. This combined model is FINAL-UNEVALUATED (no held-out test).

golden_test_vector.note: Run features_v3/sign_features_v3 on golden_test_vector.npy then the model; logits must match expected_logits (within float tolerance).

note: FINAL-UNEVALUATED: trained on S1+S2 combined. S2 was already used as the dev set for export_v3_s1, so this model has NO held-out test set. Do not promote without S2-independent validation.
